about: TEST FIXTURE (never shipped): a sample of every world-overlay feature on top of game.json. A new 1995 room S90 behind the school in Dúbravka with a new resident SAMPLE95, three new items, the side quest Q90 (topic, item use, combination, item use), its epilogue shot and a variant layer, a new atmospheric prop in the existing room S12, and two existing 1995 main actions relocated into the new room: B19 (the rhythm mark, prop click) and B22 (the P03 dial puzzle; its old hotspot S30.dial is retired). Schema: src/LastBell.Core/README.md section 13.
